message:
4 `host` bindings do not parse:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Unexpected token '{' at column 8 in [Delete {{ items().length }} rows] in [attr.title]
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Host binding expression cannot contain pipes[label() | uppercase] in [attr.placeholder]
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Got interpolation ({{}}) where expression was expected at column 0 in [{{ label() }} and {{ size() }}] in [attr.aria-valuetext]; Parser Error: Unexpected token {, expected identifier, keyword, or string at column 2 in [{{ label() }} and {{ size() }}] in [attr.aria-valuetext]; Parser Error: Unexpected token '}' at column 13 in [{{ label() }} and {{ size() }}] in [attr.aria-valuetext]
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Host binding expression cannot contain pipes[open() | json] in [attr.data-pct-state]
description: Four `host` bindings the binding parser refuses, as `ngc` does (NG5001, measured through ngc in partial mode): an interpolation, which a `host` block takes none of, a pipe, which a host binding cannot contain, two interpolations in one binding, whose three messages are one binding's, and a pipe in a binding that prints nothing, `data-pct-state`. What the parser makes of such a value is no reading of the expression, and the first one's words would pass point 3 unread; so point 1 refuses all four, by class and by the parser's messages.
